item.title: Fleet of Russia-Flagged LNG Carriers Grew 90% Y/Y to 19 Vessels in August 2026 - Reports
item.summary: MOSCOW (Sputnik) - The fleet of gas tankers for transporting liquefied natural gas (LNG) sailing under the Russian flag by August 2026 increased by 90% year-on-year to 19 vessels, the Vedomosti newspaper reported.
